title: 機械力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Dynamics of Machines II
keywords: Non-damping vibration 2.Application of non-damping vibration 3.Damping vibration and forced vibration 4.Multi-freedom vibration 5.Collaboration, Data Science
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn the basics of vibration problems that occur in machines. (2) Learn how to apply vibration analysis to mechanical designs. (3) Learn how to make a dynamic model of vibration phenomena consisting of multi-freedom vibration, and use it for analysis.
advice: This is a basic and applied course in mechanical dynamics. We will cover the following topics: 1. Non-damping vibration (keywords: linear vibration, torsional vibration, pendulum vibration) 2. Viscous damping phenomenon (keywords: damping ratio, viscous damping coefficient) 3. Forced vibration (keywords: forced vibration by external force, forced vibration by displacement) 4. Application to various vibration problems (keywords: critical speed, vibration measurement) 5. Application to multi-freedom vibration (keyword: dynamic absorber) Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
books: Textbooks: Introduction to Vibration Engineering, Tokyo Denki University (in Japanese) Reference books: Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Complete Industrial Mechanics I and II, and Dynamics of Mechanics I. Have sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential/integral and vector inner/outcome calculations) Have basic knowledge of mechanics (kinematics and moment of force). Know how to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express an appropriate model for mechanical vibration.
Be able to formulate a motion equation based on the expressed vibration model.
Be able to analyze a vibration motion equation.
Be able to apply to various vibration problems consisting of multi-freedom vibration.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to do the following things based on an understanding of various vibration phenomena in industrial machines: (1) Express mechanical vibration with the appropriate vibration model. (2) Create a formula of motion based on the expressed vibration model. (3) Calculate the solution for the formula of motion. (4) Apply the formula to various vibration problems within the multi-freedom vibration model, and design a fundamental dynamic absorber. (5) Explain the regional vibration problem.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to do the following things based on an understanding of various vibration phenomena: (1) Express mechanical vibration with a simplified vibration model. (2) Create a formula of motion based on the expressed vibration model. (3) Calculate the solution for the formula of motion. (4) Apply the formula to various vibration problems within the multi-freedom vibration model, and explain a fundamental dynamic absorber. (5) Explain the regional vibration problem.
